body_markdown:
Prevention-focused wash care is not worse by default. It is simply doing a different job. If your hair mostly feels healthy and you want to reduce future stress from styling, color, brushing, and everyday friction, a prevention-minded routine makes sense. If you are already seeing dryness, brittleness, roughness, tangling, or breakage, a targeted repair step is the more direct fit.


Think of the routine in roles: cleanse, repair, condition or moisturize, then protect before heat. Shampoo can support the wash routine, but it should not have to carry every repair and heat-protection job by itself. For existing damage, our N°.3PLUS Complete Repair Treatment is the repair-focused step: a 3-minute, protein-free pre-shampoo treatment powered by patented OLAPLEX Bond Building Technology™ and a Damage Defense Cationic Complex to rebuild all three key hair bonds from cortex to cuticle, immediately repairing damage for softer, stronger hair on all hair types.\[1\]

##


## **What Existing Dryness And Breakage Are Telling You**


Hair does not always announce damage loudly. Sometimes it shows up as ends that feel rough even after washing. Sometimes it is tangles that form faster than usual, a brittle feel when you run your fingers through your hair, flyaways that will not settle, or breakage that makes length goals feel out of reach.


That is the moment to stop asking one product to do every job. A prevention-only routine may still be useful, but visible dryness and breakage usually call for a more direct repair step. The goal is not to make a dramatic promise that every sign of damage disappears forever. The useful goal is simpler: support hair that feels softer, stronger, smoother, and easier to manage.


This is where repair claims deserve a closer look. Our N°.3PLUS Complete Repair Treatment is designed as a pre-shampoo repair treatment, not as a shampoo. It is described as a 3-minute repair for all types of hair and all types of hair damage, and it is clinically proven to create 3X softer hair and 3X stronger hair after 4 uses vs. bleached hair.\[1\]


## **Where Shampoo Fits—And Where It Does Not**


Shampoo has an important job: it cleanses and helps set up the rest of the wash routine. A well-chosen wash step can make hair feel fresher and more cared for. But when lengths and ends are already rough, brittle, or breaking, the heavier lifting often belongs to the steps built for repair, moisture, conditioning, and styling protection.


That distinction matters most if you heat style. A rinse-off wash step should not be treated as the main heat-protection step before hot tools unless that exact product is supported for that role. Heat protection belongs where the heat happens: in the styling part of the routine.


So if your hair is already showing stress, do not frame the choice as prevention or repair forever. Frame it as sequence: repair what is there, then protect what comes next.


## **The OLAPLEX Routine Logic: Repair What Is There, Protect What Is Next**


For existing damage, start with the step designed for repair. Our N°.3PLUS Complete Repair Treatment works before shampoo in 3 minutes and uses patented OLAPLEX Bond Building Technology™ with a Damage Defense Cationic Complex to rebuild all three key hair bonds from cortex to cuticle.\[1\] It also improves manageability and infuses moisture via a natural humectant derived from L-Glutamic Acid.\[1\]


That repair step is the answer when your main concern is hair that already feels compromised. It supports stronger internal hair structure over time, with 75% stronger internal hair structure reported, and helps support length retention over time by reducing breakage.\[1\]


Then, if heat styling is part of your life, add protection at the styling step. OLAPLEX Nº.7 BONDING OIL™ is a highly concentrated, weightless styling hair oil for every hair type, made with a blend of emollients, vitamin E, and sunflower seed oil to boost shine and softness, strengthen to reduce breakage, control frizz and flyaways, and provide heat protection up to 450°F/232°C.\[2\]


This is not a forced either/or. N°.3PLUS is the repair step before shampoo. OLAPLEX Nº.7 BONDING OIL™ is the styling-step complement when you want shine, smoothness, frizz control, and heat protection before hot tools. OLAPLEX Nº.7 BONDING OIL™ also delivers 125% more shine compared to bleached hair without application of OLAPLEX Nº.7 Bonding Oil™ and provides 72H frizz control and humidity resistance.\[2\]


If your priority is existing damage repair, explore N°.3PLUS Complete Repair Treatment first. If heat styling is part of your routine, consider OLAPLEX Nº.7 BONDING OIL™ as the styling-step complement for heat protection up to 450°F/232°C.\[2\]


## **How To Read Repair And Prevention Claims**


The cleanest way to judge a routine is to match the claim to the step. A repair treatment should tell you where it fits, what kind of result it supports, and the conditions around its performance claims. A styling protectant should be used in the styling role, especially when heat is involved. A shampoo can be part of a strong routine, but it should not be asked to prove results that belong to a different step.


For our product guidance, keep the claims tied to the product named with them. N°.3PLUS is the repair-focused pre-shampoo treatment with the 3-minute timing and softer, stronger hair claims.\[1\] OLAPLEX Nº.7 BONDING OIL™ is the styling oil with shine, frizz-control, breakage-reduction, and heat-protection claims.\[2\] That simple split keeps the routine clear—and keeps your expectations realistic.


## **FAQ**


### **Can one product prevent future damage and repair existing damage?**


One product can support more than one benefit, but the routine role still matters. N°.3PLUS is positioned as the repair-focused pre-shampoo treatment for existing damage, while OLAPLEX Nº.7 BONDING OIL™ is the styling-step complement for shine, frizz control, and heat protection up to 450°F/232°C. \[1\] \[2\]


If your hair already feels brittle, rough, or breakage-prone, start with the step designed for repair. If you use hot tools, add protection where it belongs: before styling.


### **If my hair is already breaking, should I stop heat styling completely?**


Not necessarily, but your routine should take breakage seriously. If heat styling is part of your routine, use a styling step that supports heat protection rather than expecting shampoo to do that job.


OLAPLEX Nº.7 BONDING OIL™ provides heat protection up to 450°F/232°C and is designed to control frizz and flyaways while boosting shine and softness.\[2\] Pairing repair before shampoo with protection before heat is the more complete logic.


### **How do I know if a product is repairing damage or just making hair feel softer?**


Look for more than a soft feel. A repair product should clearly explain its role in the routine and support claims related to strength, breakage, or damage repair—not just surface smoothness.


N°.3PLUS is a 3-minute, protein-free pre-shampoo treatment that uses patented OLAPLEX Bond Building Technology™ and a Damage Defense Cationic Complex to rebuild all three key hair bonds from cortex to cuticle.\[1\] It is also clinically proven to create 3X softer hair and 3X stronger hair after 4 uses vs. bleached hair.\[1\]


### **Should I use a repair treatment every wash?**


Do not assume every wash needs the same level of repair. Let your hair’s condition and the product’s own use directions guide the role it plays in your routine.


If your priority is visible damage, N°.3PLUS is the targeted pre-shampoo repair step to consider.\[1\] If your bigger concern is what happens next—especially heat styling—OLAPLEX Nº.7 BONDING OIL™ belongs in the styling step, where it can provide heat protection up to 450°F/232°C.\[2\]


## **The Bottom Line**


Prevention and repair are not rivals. They are partners with different timing. Prevention helps you think ahead; repair addresses what your hair is already showing you. If dryness, roughness, tangling, or breakage are part of your current hair story, start with a true repair step, then protect your style before heat.


That is the confident routine: repair what is there, protect what is next, and give your hair the kind of support that makes every style feel more possible.
